phase_name: Guardian Web Hybrid v3 — accessibility tree first + visual OCR fallback

last_physical_finding.conclusion: Screenshot/OCR worked technically; the remaining bottleneck is host-reading/acceptance strategy and private-mode probing, not permission or ML Kit.

implemented_in_0_1_24: Known accessibility URL-bar IDs are read synchronously in the event callback before any screenshot
URL-bar extraction no longer requires isVisibleToUser; focused/typing guard remains
Bounded tree fallback runs off the accessibility callback thread
Last valid host remains banked while UsageStats confirms the same browser stays foreground
OCR remains a fallback and still requires two consecutive visual host reads
Private visual probe can run after a normal host is already known
Private-to-normal Chromium transitions require positive accessibility evidence (for example the standard-tab Enter Incognito mode toggle); missing markers never clear private mode
visual_private_probe_count now counts attempts; visual_private_detected_count counts positives
API 34+ takeScreenshotOfWindow is preferred when a browser window ID is known
If per-window screenshot fails, Guardian records the diagnostic and falls back to the proven display screenshot path
ERROR_TAKE_SCREENSHOT_SECURE_WINDOW is exported as secure_browser_window evidence only, never auto-equated with incognito
DEV diagnostics export browser tree resource IDs only, including bounded normal/private inventories per browser when mode is known
Expanded browser catalog and accessibility allowlist; Mi Browser included without a guessed URL-bar ID
BrowserWebAccess returns one immutable status snapshot for repeated calls using the validation pack timestamp
No database schema expansion and no new persisted user-content category
No INTERNET or ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE in the merged APK contract
next_task: Upload the 0.1.24 Hybrid v3 files, verify GitHub Actions is green, install over 0.1.23, then test Chrome Dev normal (uol.com.br and globo.com ~20s each), Chrome Dev incognito start page + a third host ~20s, optionally Mi Browser normal/private, return to Guardian and export one validation JSON. Check tree hits, visual fallback, private probe attempts/detections, secure-window signal and browser_tree_resource_ids.
